text: ただいま　カードの　はいふは　おこなわれて　いないようです…

structure.jp: カードの　はいふは
おこなわれて　いないようです…
structure.en: it seems it is not being done

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.explanation: ようだ after a word says 'it seems that'. It is a guess from what you can see. いないようです = 'it seems there are none'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.span: おこなわれて　いない
patterns.explanation: ている says something is going on, and いない is its 'not' form. おこなわれて　いない = 'is not being carried out'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The れる ending says the action is done by someone unnamed, so things just happen. おこなわれて = 'being carried out'.
